allocation.rule: receipts are applied to invoices exactly as listed in invoice_refs
allocation.unreferenced: receipts with null invoice_refs are held in 2400 Unapplied Customer Receipts

fx.conversion: convert the document amount once and round to target minor units
fx.missing_date: use the latest published rate on or before that date
fx.quote: 1 unit of source_currency = rate units of target_currency
fx.rate_date: local date of the document in the company timezone
fx.receipts: AR is credited at the invoice carrying rate; the difference to cash at the receipt-date rate is booked to 7900 Realized FX Gain/Loss

duplicate_invoice.evidence: both invoice doc_ids and one posting row_id (AR debit or revenue credit) of each copy

fx_conversion.affected_ids: doc_id of the document whose conversion into the ledger currency is wrong
fx_conversion.amount: absolute difference between the booked amount and convert(document amount, policy rate, policy rounding); booked amount = AR row for an invoice, cash row for a payment
fx_conversion.evidence: document doc_id, the converted posting row_id (invoice: AR or revenue row; payment: cash row) and the policy rate as fx id 'date|source|target'

payment_allocation.amount: amount of that payment booked to 2400 Unapplied Customer Receipts
payment_allocation.evidence: payment doc_id and its 2400 Unapplied Customer Receipts row_id

period_cutoff.affected_ids: doc_id of the document booked in a different period than its own local date
period_cutoff.amount: base amount of the mis-dated posting (invoice: AR row; payment: cash row)
period_cutoff.evidence: document doc_id and the mis-dated posting row_id (invoice: AR or revenue row; payment: cash row)

ledger.credit_notes: invoices with negative total_minor are credit notes (AR credit, 4100 Sales Returns debit); payments with negative amount_minor are refunds paid to the customer
ledger.entries: rows of one journal entry share the same timestamp
ledger.null_references: missing references are null; links are never guessed
ledger.posting_date: documents are posted at their own timestamp: invoices at issued_at, payments at timestamp

period.assignment: an item belongs to the period that contains the local date of its document timestamp
period.boundary: inclusive local dates in the company timezone
period.review_window: records dated after period end up to review_window_end belong to the NEXT period and are included only for cut-off review

rounding.scope: each conversion, to target minor units
